document.title: Publish PR reviews to GitHub Pages
document.summary: `scripts/pages-review.ts` and the pages skill copy a static folder onto `gh-pages` at `pr/<n>/` or `site/<name>/`. A workflow removes a PR folder on close and drops sites older than 30 days.
document.why: [PR #67](source:s1) hosts comprehende exports on this repo's GitHub Pages instead of VibeDrop. [The session](source:s5) wants a pages skill that can upload a static site at any point, including without a pull request.

sources.label: cursor[bot] on PR #67
sources.gist: Concurrent publishes conflict on index.html. rebase with allowFail swallows the conflict, so retries never push.
sources.author: cursor[bot]
sources.body:
### Push retry cannot resolve listing conflicts **Medium Severity** Every publish and prune rewrites the root `index.html` listing. Concurrent updates conflict on that file; `rebase` with `allowFail` swallows the conflict, so the five retries never recover and the review is not pushed.
Additional Locations (1) - [`scripts/pages-review.ts#L231-L236`](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/blob/16565def6a52a638a09689dc5f6ddfe45cab1504/scripts/pages-review.ts#L231-L236)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 16565def6a52a638a09689dc5f6ddfe45cab1504. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

sources.label: cursor[bot] on PR #67
sources.gist: A rejected push now resets to remote gh-pages and re-applies, then rebuilds the listing from published.json.
sources.author: cursor[bot]
sources.body:
Fixed in d6ec9ee. A rejected push now resets to the remote `gh-pages` tip and re-applies the local review, then rebuilds `index.html` from `published.json`. Rebase is gone, so a listing conflict no longer eats the retry.

Posted by Cursor Grok 4.6 [cursor-grok-4.6]

sources.gist: Asked to host with a separate pages skill, like VibeDrop, including named uploads that are not pull requests.

sources.label: cursor[bot] on PR #67
sources.gist: Pages is still off for the repo, so the URL 404s until Settings enables the gh-pages branch.
sources.author: cursor[bot]
sources.body:
The 404 is GitHub Pages still off for this repo (the Pages API returns 404, so GitHub is not serving `gh-pages` yet). The review files are on the `gh-pages` branch under `pr/67/`.

Enable it once: Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → `gh-pages` / `/`. After that, https://matemolnar8.github.io/comprehende/pr/67/ should load. I cannot flip that setting from here.

Posted by Cursor Grok 4.6 [cursor-grok-4.6]

groups.title: Pages publish CLI
groups.why: [PR #67](source:s1) needs a way to copy a static folder onto `gh-pages`. [Bugbot](source:s3) found listing races on that path.
groups.summary: `publish` and `prune` in `scripts/pages-review.ts` write `pr/<n>/` or `site/<slug>/` and rebuild the listing from `published.json` after a rejected push.
lookFor: Race. Two publishes rewrite `index.html`. On a rejected push, `applyAndPush` does `reset --hard` to remote `gh-pages` and runs `apply` again.
For dest `{ kind: "name", name: "demo" }`, the copy lands in `site/demo/` and `prune --pr` leaves it.

groups.title: Close and TTL prune
groups.why: [PR #67](source:s1) says a closed pull request should drop its folder, and old sites should expire.
groups.summary: `.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml` runs `prune --pr` on close and `prune --ttl-days 30` on a daily cron.
lookFor: Subtle. The close job runs `prune --pr` only, so `site/<name>/` remains until TTL.

groups.title: Pages skill
groups.why: [The session](source:s5) wants hosting as a separate skill, like VibeDrop, that can run at any point.
groups.summary: The pages skill and `AGENTS.md` tell agents to host with the CLI, and `.agents/skills/vibedrop/SKILL.md` is deleted.
lookFor: Step 2 uses `--pr` for a pull request review and `--name` for any other static folder.

groups.title: Pages CLI tests
groups.why: The dest and retry behavior needs checks that do not hit origin.
groups.summary: `scripts/pages-review.test.ts` covers publish, prune, named dests, and listing replay, and `package.json` includes it in `pnpm test`.
lookFor: The concurrent test publishes `site/demo/` while another client writes `pr/99/`. After retry, both folders exist and the listing names them.

commits.subject: Support named GitHub Pages uploads without a pull request
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Publish takes exactly one dest: --pr for pr/<n>/, or --name for site/<slug>/. Closing a PR still only removes that PR folder. TTL drops both.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Add a pages skill to host static sites on GitHub Pages
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Checkout-only skill, same shape as the old VibeDrop skill: upload a static folder at any point. AGENTS.md points at it instead of inlining the publish command.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Keep GitHub Pages publish out of the comprehende skill
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
pages-review.ts is this repo's PR flow. The skill stays generic: export the static site to the folder they named.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Replay Pages publishes onto gh-pages instead of rebasing
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Concurrent publishes both rewrite index.html. rebase with allowFail left the conflict in place, so retries never pushed. Reset to the remote tip and re-apply the local review so the listing is rebuilt from published.json.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Publish PR reviews to GitHub Pages instead of VibeDrop
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Export still writes a static site. This repo now pushes it to gh-pages at pr/<n>/. A workflow removes the folder when the PR closes, and drops reviews older than 30 days.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
